places-abrigo-grande-de-minateda-cueva-a.story: From Hellín it runs 248 km to Hellín; allow about 4 h 17 of riding. It goes by way of Cueva del Esquilo, Cueva Ambrosio and back through Cueva del Esquilo. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
